learning_objective: 🎯 Expand your superpower word bank by learning words that mean the same and words that are exact opposites!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Synonyms are words that have the exact same or very similar meaning! Instead of saying 'big', you can say 'large' or 'huge'. They make our writing so much fun!
Antonyms are words that mean the exact opposite of each other! The antonym of 'hot' is 'cold', and the antonym of 'fast' is 'slow'.
Using lots of different synonyms and antonyms helps you become an amazing writer. It stops your stories from sounding boring and repetitive!

fun_activity.title: 🆚 The Opposite Rapid Fire
fun_activity.instructions: Play a quick game with a friend! You say a word like 'Happy', and they must quickly shout out the Antonym (Sad). Take turns and see how fast you can go!

quick_recap: ⭐ Synonyms are different words that share the same meaning.
⭐ Antonyms are words that mean the exact opposite of each other.
⭐ Learning new words makes your reading and writing much stronger!
